answer: Registration also demands solving a rotating sonnet-seeded puzzle, so mass-producing identities costs real compute and forfeited stake per attempt, making fake agents economically irrational. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to forge a unique proof-of-work stamp bound to its identity, then stake that stamp in a shared velvet registry where duplicate or cloned identities are slashed. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
